adapter_contract.numeric_selector: Owned Input -> Decision; helper predictions/predicates are explicit PES-unit inputs.
adapter_contract.numeric_speed: Owned SpeedInput -> integer amplitude. Zero target skips update.
adapter_contract.amplitudes_and_time: PES integer amplitude/frame/configuration units require verified conversion to native metres, seconds and 10 ms steps.
adapter_contract.pose: Requires verified 19-to-13-bone retarget, side/bind/axes/scale before native Animation insertion.
adapter_contract.contact: Keep native GetBestCheatableAnimID feasibility and FootballAnimationExtension contact timing; PES foot/head contact metadata not recovered.
adapter_contract.native_candidates: The catalogue offers source candidates and compatibility requirements, not final runtime ranking.
adapter_contract.fallback: Approved native selector remains active until a full imported clip/transition is validated.

scope: Automatic association of original decisions with their recovered conditions and catalogue contract. No manually guessed PES labels, PES/native ID equality, enabled clip import, final native selection, complete action, PS2 frame or gameplay equivalence.
